description:
Get cost in USD across a date range, broken out by dimension.

Returns one row per combination of the requested `group_by[]`
dimensions (and time bucket, when `time_bucket_width` is set) that has
cost in the range, ranked by spend or ordered by time bucket; every
combination is returned across pages. With no `group_by[]` and no
`time_bucket_width`, a single row aggregates the whole range. Includes
all cost, whether or not it is attributable to a seat user. Requires an
API key with the `read:analytics` scope, or an Admin API key.

Data beyond this watermark is incomplete; for stable results, set `ending_at` to this value or earlier. Data is typically refreshed every 4 hours. Values can be revised as late events arrive and reconciliation runs, until about 7 days after the end of the calendar month the usage falls in; for example, values for October 1 can change until about November 7.

BetaAnalyticsFlatCostGroup.description:
The dimension values one cost row is broken out by, including
`cost_type` and `token_type`.

actor.description: The identity the usage is attributed to: the user if one is attributed, else the service account, else the federated (cloud-platform) identity, else the API key. Populated only when `actor` is in `group_by[]`; null for usage with no attributable identity, and for users' and federated identities' usage when the reader is a member who can see only some workspaces. Distinct identities the server cannot render also read null, each as its own row.

actor_type.description: Kind of identity the usage is attributed to; matches `actor.type` when `actor` is set. Populated only when `actor_type` is in `group_by[]`.

agent_id.description: Claude Managed Agents agent whose session incurred the usage. Populated only when `agent_id` is in `group_by[]`; null for usage outside a managed session.
agent_id.title: Agent Id

api_key_id.description: API key that authenticated the requests, as a tagged API key ID, whichever identity `actor` resolves to. Populated only when `api_key_id` is in `group_by[]`; null for usage not authenticated by an API key.
api_key_id.title: Api Key Id

claude_tag_category.description: Claude Tag (Claude in Slack) spend category: `engaged` (a person addressed Claude in a channel or thread), `proactive` (Claude responded without being addressed), `scheduled` (a scheduled routine ran), `monitoring` (Claude watching a channel it was asked to monitor), or `dm` (direct messages with Claude). Populated only when `claude_tag_category` is in `group_by[]`; null for usage that is not Claude Tag. New categories may be added over time.

claude_tag_user_id.description: Slack user ID (for example `U0123ABCDEF`) of the member the Claude Tag (Claude in Slack) usage is attributed to, not a claude.ai user ID. Populated only when `claude_tag_user_id` is in `group_by[]`; null for usage that is not Claude Tag and for Claude Tag usage that is not attributed to a single user (for example `monitoring`, and `proactive` usage Claude initiated), so per-user rows can sum to less than the Claude Tag total. Cannot be combined with `group_by[]=rbac_group_id` or the `rbac_group_ids[]` filter.
claude_tag_user_id.title: Claude Tag User Id

context_window.description: Context-window pricing tier of the usage or cost. Null unless `context_window` is in `group_by[]`; it can also be null on grouped rows with no context-window tier, such as code execution.

cost_type.description: Cost component breakdown; null when returning the combined total.

deployment_id.description: Deployment that started the Claude Managed Agents session. Populated only when `deployment_id` is in `group_by[]`; null for usage outside a managed session and for sessions no deployment started.
deployment_id.title: Deployment Id

environment_id.description: Claude Managed Agents environment the session ran in. Populated only when `environment_id` is in `group_by[]`; null for usage outside a managed session.
environment_id.title: Environment Id

inference_geo.description: Inference region of the usage or cost. Null unless `inference_geo` is in `group_by[]`; it can also be null on grouped rows where the region is not set (the rows that `inference_geos[]=not_available` matches).

model.description: Model that produced the usage or cost, as a model name in the form the `models[]` filter accepts (for example, `claude-opus-5-5`). Null unless `model` is in `group_by[]`; it can also be null on grouped rows whose usage or cost is not attributed to a specific model, such as code execution.
model.title: Model

organization_id.description: UUID of the child organization the usage belongs to, on a parent organization's report across its children. Null unless `organization_id` is in `group_by[]`.
organization_id.title: Organization Id

product.description: Product surface that produced the usage or cost. Null unless product is in `group_by[]`; it can also be null on grouped rows whose usage cannot be attributed to a known surface. Values include `chat`, `claude_code`, `cowork`, `office_agent`, `claude_in_chrome`, `claude_design`, `claude_tag`, and `chat_cowork_unified`. `claude_tag` is Claude Tag, the Claude product in Slack. `chat_cowork_unified` is Chat and Cowork unified, Cowork's features inside claude.ai chat: chat and Cowork usage by a member who has it turned on is reported under this value instead of `chat` or `cowork`. It is accepted as a filter only where Chat and Cowork unified is available. Some unattributed usage is reported as "other".

rbac_group_id.description: RBAC group (team) the usage is attributed to, in the public tagged `rbac_group_...` spelling — the same spelling the activity resources use for this key, so the same team has one id across resources and it round-trips as an `rbac_group_ids[]` filter value. Populated only when `rbac_group_id` is in `group_by[]`. Any-membership semantics: a user in several groups contributes their full usage to each of those groups' rows, so the named-group rows overlap and their sum can exceed the org total. A null value is the single unassigned row: users in no group on that (UTC) day. For the true org total, run the same query without `group_by[]`.
rbac_group_id.title: Rbac Group Id

service_tier.description: Service tier the usage was served at. Populated only when `service_tier` is in `group_by[]`; null for usage with no service tier (for example, code execution) and for Claude Enterprise usage.

session_id.description: Claude Managed Agents session that incurred the usage. Populated only when `session_id` is in `group_by[]`; null for usage outside a managed session.
session_id.title: Session Id

slack_channel_id.description: Slack channel the usage originated from. Populated only when `slack_channel_id` is in `group_by[]`; null for usage outside Slack, for some Claude Tag usage that has no channel recorded, and for usage recorded before channel attribution was enabled.
slack_channel_id.title: Slack Channel Id

speed.description: Inference speed mode of the usage or cost: `fast` or `standard`. Null unless `speed` is in `group_by[]`.

token_type.description: Token type when `cost_type` is `tokens`; null otherwise.

user_profile_id.description: User profile the usage was attributed to, as a tagged `uprof_` ID. Populated only when `user_profile_id` is in `group_by[]`; null for usage that named no profile and for Claude Enterprise usage.
user_profile_id.title: User Profile Id

workspace_id.description: Workspace the usage occurred in, as a tagged workspace ID, including the organization's default workspace. Populated only when `workspace_id` is in `group_by[]`; null for Claude Enterprise usage.

deleted.description: True when the account has been deleted, or when the user is no longer a member of the organization or its associated organizations (for example, their membership was removed or they were deprovisioned via your identity provider). `email_address` stays populated for removed users and is null when the account has been deleted. `name` follows the rules described on that field. The `user_id` is still populated for reconciliation.
deleted.title: Deleted

email_address.description: The user's current email address, including for users who are no longer members of the organization. Null when the account has been deleted and for system-minted service accounts.
email_address.title: Email Address

name.description: The user's current full name. Null when the user has not set one. `"Deleted User"` when the account has been deleted, or when the user is no longer a member and the organization hides removed users' names.
name.title: Name

provider.description: The trusted provider that asserted the caller's identity.

subject.description: The provider's identifier for the caller: on `aws`, the IAM principal ARN (one role is one actor across its sessions); on `gcp`, the caller's IAM principal identifier as Google Cloud reports it, such as `serviceAccount:<email>`, `user:<email>`, or a `principal://...` URI.
subject.title: Subject

account_id.description: The AWS account the organization is bound to.
account_id.title: Account Id

signed_principal.description: The AWS-signed ARN of the IAM principal that made the requests.
signed_principal.title: Signed Principal

subscription_id.description: The Azure subscription the organization is bound to.
subscription_id.title: Subscription Id

project_number.description: The Google Cloud project the organization is bound to.
